_note: Festivals, national days and world days in the countries the apps are sold in. A story with "occasion": "<key>" and post_on on that date wins the day whatever the four-day cycle says. costumes = pose-catalogue variants to use for the characters that day. Dates are for the 2026/27 season; lunar dates checked against published calendars.

occasions.name: Halloween
occasions.hook: The one night it is normal to wear a mask. On Waypoint you take yours off: one true sentence, under a name nobody knows.

occasions.name: Dhanteras
occasions.hook: The day shops buy for the season. Lumi: before you buy, know what is in the drawer, not just on the shelf.

occasions.name: Diwali
occasions.hook: Lights in every shop; Lumi wishes a bright season and a clear book. Mira: a festival night is loud, Waypoint keeps one quiet minute for you.

occasions.name: Bhai Dooj
occasions.hook: A day for brothers and sisters; a sentence you never said to yours.

occasions.name: World Kindness Day
occasions.hook: One kind sentence on the Wall travels further than you think.

occasions.name: Children's Day (India)
occasions.hook: The shop that pays for the school fees: a score that keeps it healthy.

occasions.name: International Men's Day
occasions.hook: The founder: men say 'all good' by habit. Say one true sentence instead.

occasions.name: Guru Nanak Jayanti
occasions.hook: Honest work, shared bread: a shop's book in plain words.

occasions.name: Thanksgiving
occasions.hook: ScoreMyBiz: the small shop that fed the street this year. Waypoint: the table is full and one person still has not said it.

occasions.name: Small Business Saturday
occasions.hook: The founder: the busiest weekend of the year, and the one number that tells you if it paid.

occasions.name: UAE National Day
occasions.hook: A trading nation's small shops; Lumi in Arabic.

occasions.name: National Farmers' Day (Ghana)
occasions.hook: The farm gate shop: Sold, Bought, Spent in plain words.

occasions.name: Jamhuri Day (Kenya)
occasions.hook: Lumi in Swahili: duka, book, score.

occasions.name: Christmas
occasions.hook: ScoreMyBiz: the Christmas rush in one number. Waypoint: the quietest hour of the loudest day.

occasions.name: New Year
occasions.hook: One number to start the year honestly; one sentence to start it true.

occasions.name: Lohri / Makar Sankranti / Pongal
occasions.hook: Harvest: the season's sales, and what is left after the buying.

occasions.name: Republic Day (India) / Australia Day
occasions.hook: A nation of shopkeepers; Lumi with the tricolour.

occasions.name: Waitangi Day (New Zealand)
occasions.hook: The corner dairy and its book.

occasions.name: Valentine's Day
occasions.hook: The sentence you did not send. Say it once, to no one, and see how it feels.

occasions.name: Ghana Independence Day
occasions.hook: Lumi in kente: every market stall has a score.

occasions.name: Holi
occasions.hook: Colour on every shirt; the book stays clean.
